"Opens your system browser with PKCE. Spotify development apps require a Premium app owner and allow up to five registered testers. Only owned or collaborative playlists expose their contents; followed and automatic mixes may be unavailable."
"To find playable equivalents, selected song titles and artists are searched on YouTube. Uncertain versions need your review. Spotify audio is never played or downloaded."

"Opens Google in your system browser with PKCE. A Sonora-operated HTTPS broker exchanges the one-time code; it must not store or log credentials. Read-only access lists playlists owned by the selected YouTube channel, including Music playlists when the API exposes them. Saved third-party lists, radio mixes, uploads and the full Music library are not guaranteed. Takeout remains available."
"Also read liked songs (adds library read permission)"
"Also read YouTube liked videos (may include non-music; not a complete YouTube Music likes export)"

"Exports usually omit playlist IDs. Reimporting the same name merges into its previous file-import destination; renaming it creates a new one. API imports remain separate unless the export contains a playlist ID."

"Choose a ZIP or CSV from Google Takeout. Works with private playlists, library songs and exported likes."
"How do I export my playlists and likes?"

"1. Open Google Takeout in your browser and select YouTube and YouTube Music.
2. Select playlists and music-library data; leave uploaded videos out. Choose a downloadable ZIP, not transfer to another service.
3. Download the ZIP, return here, and choose it. You can also select individual CSV files.
4. Review each list and select Favorites for your liked songs. Google may omit some likes; Sonora can only import tracks included in your files."
"Open https://takeout.google.com in a browser on your phone or computer."
